newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis, Palestinians clash in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israelis, Palestinians clash in Hebron.

text.p: Israeli soldiers on Friday fired rubber bullets to disperse Palestinian stone-throwers on a ninth day of protests against Jewish settlement construction in Arab East Jerusalem, witnesses said.

They said six Palestinians were taken to hospital with rubber bullet wounds during the clash in the West Bank town of Hebron which is split between Israeli and PLO rule. Palestinian police tried to help contain the riot.

In Jerusalem, U.S. presidential envoy Dennis Ross shuttled between Israelis and Palestinians hoping to rescue Middle East peacemaking, which plunged into crisis over Israel's groundbreaking for the settlement of 6,500 homes for Jews.

Palestinians want a stop to the hilltop settlement which Israelis call Har Homa and the Arabs call Jabal Abu Ghneim. Israel demands an end to violence that climaxed a week ago when a suicide bomber killed three women at a Tel Aviv cafe.
